recognition.summary: Consenting reporters may receive voluntary public credit; informational recognition is available on request.

reporting.summary: The policy provides a direct reporting email link.

rewards.summary: First qualifying reports may receive discretionary paid awards; no legal entitlement is created.

limitations: The email address is protected in text extraction; follow the policy link. The policy expressly offers neither legal immunity nor a promise to refrain from legal action.
rights: Original summary CC BY 4.0; linked sources and trademarks retain their own rights.
